headline.family_guess: serif display (Canela/Tiempos-like) mixed with a plain sans for emphasis words
headline.size_rel: large, 2-3 word lines, animates in with kinetic-type word-by-word reveal

caption.family_guess: same serif italic for accent words, sans for base text
caption.size_rel: medium, 1-2 lines, no box, plain color text with a colored italic keyword

layout.host_pos: center-frame, chest-up, bookshelf background, static camera
layout.safe_zones: top 12% and bottom 15% kept clear of dense UI for caption/CTA text
layout.caption_pos: center-upper third, overlaid directly on host or on cream/black UI background

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: 6-9 (fast — mostly UI-graphic beats under 1s each, host beats held longer at 2-4s)

themeable: accent2 (UI card/chat-bubble color, currently dark green)
file/card labels (e.g. Agents.md, Memory.md, Context.md, Skills.md)
